provenance.creator: Albrecht Dürer
provenance.culturalContext: Embroidery Pattern with Round Medallion in its Center; printed embroidery pattern, not an Arabic or Ukrainian attribution.

permission.evidence: Retained official Met API object 388374 isPublicDomain=true; Met Open Access CC0 policy https://www.metmuseum.org/about-the-met/policies-and-documents/open-access

review.method: Manual review of one lower central knotwork crossing in source resized to 1408 pixels, crop (500,320,350,400), zoom ROI (60,230,130,110)
limitations: Two short approximate strand centrelines only; not full design tracing or independent expert annotations.
Under-strand interruption is interpolated as a continuity hypothesis; its hidden pixels are not observed.
Image geometry is not physically calibrated; no stitch order or machine approval.

elements.evidence: Reviewed source detail: uninterrupted descending light strand; approximate centreline endpoints in sixfold zoom; hidden continuation is explicitly hypothetical.

elements.hypothesis: rising light strand interrupted at the descending strand
